known.title: The repaired visibility lookup gives gh a bare owner/name, so GH_HOST can send the lookup to another host
known.locator: Research, Decisions 2 (line 27); Research, Facts (line 19); Steps, row 2 visibility_check (line 42)
known.summary: Decision 2 (line 27) takes the owner and name from each github.com remote. Then it runs `gh repo view <owner>/<repo> --json visibility` without a host. gh gives a bare owner/name its default host, and `GH_HOST` sets that host (gh environment manual); the Facts (line 19) test only `GH_REPO`. When `GH_HOST` names another host that has a public repository with the same owner/name, the lookup prints PUBLIC for a private project. The draft then keeps the private branch names and issue titles that the Goal keeps out, and the lookup for other named repositories has the same gap.
